name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: The Burt Corner Sofa from the Naustro Fiera Collection is characterized by sartorial elegance and rich, refined details. Its design includes crisscross stitching on the headrest and armrest, alongside double side stitching that emphasizes the perimeter. Available in fabric or leather covers with metal feet, this corner sofa offers transformable comfort through a dual-motor seat recliner and an electric vertical-type headrest, which can also be manually adjusted forward. Several layouts are available, including Corner, Corner with Terminal, Maxi Chaise, and Chaise options.
